name: Word Count Goal Tracker
author: Divyesh Mishra

sections.description:
Word Count Goal Tracker helps bloggers, authors, and content creators stay consistent and productive by turning every post into a clear writing target.

Whether you write daily blogs, long-form articles, or creative content, this plugin makes it easy to set word goals and track progress in real time — right inside your editor.

✨ Latest Update

We’ve improved the Dashboard experience to help you track your writing progress more clearly:

– New Today’s Progress card with live word count and goal completion
– Visual streak tracking (current streak & best streak) to keep you motivated
– Last 7 Days summary to quickly see your recent writing activity
– Recent Activity list showing your latest posts and word counts
– Cleaner layout and better spacing for improved readability

Your existing posts will keep their own goals — the global goal just helps you set a starting point for new content.

💡 Perfect for:

  • Bloggers who want consistent post lengths.
  • Authors who track writing productivity.
  • SEO writers who follow editorial word targets.

Features

  • Global Word Goal Settings – Automatically apply a default word goal to all new posts.
  • Per-Post Custom Goals – Each post can have its own individual word target.
  • Live Progress Bar – Visual indicator that updates automatically as you write.
  • Progress Notification – Instant alert when you reach your goal.
  • Dashboard Integration – Easy access and management from one place.
  • Lightweight and Fast – Minimal code, built for performance.
  • Compatible with Classic and Block Editors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Settings → Word Count Goal Tracker to set your global word goal.
  4. Start writing new posts — they’ll automatically use your default goal.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change my content?

No. It only tracks your word count and goal progress. It never modifies your post content.

What’s the difference between global and per-post goals?

The global goal sets a default for new posts so you don’t have to set it each time.
You can still assign different goals to individual posts if needed.

Can I see my goal progress while writing?

Yes! The live progress bar updates automatically as you write inside the post editor.
